Mathematical Problem
8 singers participate in the arts festival, preparing to arrange mm performances, each time 4 of them will perform on stage, requiring that any two of the 8 singers perform together the same number of times. Please design a scheme so that the number of performances mm is the least.

Chunk 1
To solve this problem, we need to ensure that each pair of singers performs together in the same number of performances. This is a specific type of combinatorial design problem, and the solution can be approached using the concept of a balanced incomplete block design (BIBD).
Here are the steps to find the solution: 1. Identify the parameters of the BIBD:
